title: The Growth Mindset
subtitle: 考点：学习态度 / feedback, mindset, take advantage of
passage: Some students think they are simply good or bad at maths. Teachers call this a fixed mindset. Other students believe that they can grow if they work hard and use good strategies. This is called a growth mindset. Students with a growth mindset do not give up when a problem is difficult.

Tom used to say, 'I am bad at science.' Then his teacher showed him how to take advantage of mistakes. Tom looked at his wrong answers, asked for feedback and tried again. He also joined a hands-on project with his classmates. By the end of the term, his marks were much higher. Tom now says, 'My brain is like a muscle. The more I use it, the stronger it gets.'
